airspace.zh: 南提洛自2023年1月30日起，在十八處保護區禁止飛行二十五公斤以下的無人機（不論是否裝有相機），包括三峰、法內斯-塞內斯-布拉耶斯與普埃茲-奧德勒自然公園；義大利民航局ENAC已把這項限制列為地理區ENV-002，標示在D-Flight地圖上。威尼托一側的安佩佐多洛米蒂自然公園，則規定未經公園書面許可不得飛越。此外，各類無人機飛行高度上限為120公尺，須在D-Flight登記並投保。實際飛行前請先確認最新規定。
airspace.en: Since 30 January 2023 South Tyrol has banned drones under 25 kg, camera or not, in 18 protected areas, including the Tre Cime, Fanes-Sennes-Braies and Puez-Odle nature parks; Italy's aviation authority ENAC lists this as geographic zone ENV-002 on the D-Flight map. On the Veneto side, the Ampezzo Dolomites park forbids overflights without its written permission. Every drone is also limited to 120 m and must be registered on D-Flight and insured. Check the current rules before any real flight.

title.en: A Front Line in the Mountains

tagline.zh-Hant: 以多洛米厄命名的岩石、一次大戰的山中戰線、兩屆冬奧與世界遺產
tagline.en: A rock named after Dolomieu in 1791, a First World War front, two Winter Olympics and World Heritage in 2009

zh: 多洛米蒂山脈在義大利東北部，
2009年6月26日列入世界遺產。
en: The Dolomites rise in north-eastern Italy;
they were inscribed as World Heritage on 26 June 2009.

zh: 這裡的岩層，記錄了大約兩億五千萬年的地球歷史，
細節豐富，而且連續不斷。
en: Their rocks record about 250 million years of Earth's history
in rich and continuous detail.

zh: 1789到1790年，法國學者多洛米厄考察阿爾卑斯山，
1791年，他描述了一種新的礦物。
en: In 1789–90 the French geologist Déodat de Dolomieu studied the Alps,
and in 1791 he described a new mineral.

zh: 這種礦物後來以他命名，叫做「白雲石」；
他最早以科學研究這片山區，山脈也因他得名。
en: The mineral, dolomite, was named after him;
he made the first scientific study of the region, which bears his name.

zh: 1864年，格羅曼首登馬爾莫拉達；
1869年8月21日，他又和兩位嚮導首登三峰最高的大峰。
en: Paul Grohmann made the first ascent of the Marmolada in 1864,
and on 21 August 1869, with two guides, of Cima Grande, highest of the Tre Cime.

zh: 1915到1917年，義大利與奧匈帝國的前線，
就穿過這些山峰。
en: From 1915 to 1917 the front line between Italy and Austria-Hungary
ran through these peaks.

zh: 雙方都在拉加佐伊山裡挖掘坑道，
想從山的內部奪下對方的陣地。
en: Both sides dug tunnels into Lagazuoi,
trying to take the other's positions from inside the mountain.

zh: 這些坑道今天開放參觀，
成了一座藏在山裡的戰爭博物館。
en: Those tunnels are open today,
in effect a museum inside the mountain.

zh: 在馬爾莫拉達，奧匈帝國的士兵，
就住在北面冰河裡挖出來的坑道中。
en: On the Marmolada Austro-Hungarian soldiers
lived in tunnels dug into the northern glacier.

zh: 三峰一直位在國界上，到1919年為止；
科蒂納在1920年正式割讓給義大利。
en: The Tre Cime stood on the border until 1919;
Cortina d'Ampezzo was definitively ceded to Italy in 1920.

zh: 原定1944年在科蒂納舉行的冬季奧運，因二次大戰取消，
1956年才終於在這裡舉辦。
en: The Winter Olympics planned for Cortina in 1944 were cancelled by the Second World War;
they were finally held here in 1956.

zh: 那是第一屆現場直播的冬季奧運，
黑白畫面傳到了歐洲八個國家。
en: They were the first Winter Games broadcast live,
in black and white, to eight European countries.

zh: 2010年5月13日，多洛米蒂聯合國教科文基金會成立，
地址就在科蒂納丹佩佐。
en: On 13 May 2010 the Dolomites UNESCO Foundation was established,
with its address in Cortina d'Ampezzo.

zh: 馬爾莫拉達的冰塔崩塌，十一人罹難。
en: On 3 July 2022
a serac collapsed on the Marmolada, killing eleven people.

zh: 2026年，科蒂納和米蘭共同主辦冬季奧運，
這是它第二次主辦奧運。
en: In 2026 Cortina co-hosted the Winter Olympics with Milan,
its second time hosting the Games.

zh: 從學者的考察、戰爭的前線，
到全世界登山客的目的地，這些山記得一切。
en: From a scholar's survey and a wartime front
to a destination for climbers from all over the world, these mountains remember it all.

tagline.zh-Hant: 從拉丁語演變的拉登語、五個拉登語山谷、高山小屋與纜車，與保護山區的規定
tagline.en: A language left by Latin, five Ladin valleys, mountain huts and cable cars, and rules that protect the peaks

zh: 多洛米蒂有五個山谷，至今還說拉登語。
它是從民間拉丁語流傳下來的羅曼語。
en: Five valleys of the Dolomites still speak Ladin,
a Romance language surviving from Vulgar Latin in the Alps.

zh: 它和羅曼什語、弗留利語是近親；
2011年，南提洛約有兩萬零五百人以它為母語。
en: It is closely related to Romansh and Friulian;
in 2011 about 20,500 people in South Tyrol gave it as their mother tongue.

zh: 加爾代納谷約有八到九成居民說拉登語，
巴迪亞谷更高達九成五。
en: In Val Gardena 80 to 90% of the people speak Ladin;
in Val Badia the figure is 95%.

zh: 馬爾莫拉達山下的法薩谷，
有百分之八十二點八的人以拉登語為母語。
en: In the Fassa Valley below the Marmolada
82.8% are native Ladin speakers.

zh: 科蒂納的居民，多半說當地的安佩佐方言，
它和鄰近的卡多雷方言很接近。
en: Most people in Cortina speak Ampezzano, the local variety of Ladin,
which is close to the neighbouring Cadore dialect.

zh: 1972年的自治法，讓拉登語在南提洛成為部分官方語言；
在貝盧諾，它從1999年起受到法律保護。
en: The 1972 autonomy statute made Ladin partly official in South Tyrol;
in Belluno it has been protected by law since 1999.

zh: 科蒂納鎮中心海拔一千兩百二十四公尺，
平時約五千四百人，冬天會增加到大約四萬人。
en: The centre of Cortina lies at 1,224 metres;
around 5,400 people live here, rising to some 40,000 in winter.

zh: 歐倫佐小屋海拔約兩千三百二十公尺，
有收費道路從米蘇里納通到這裡，是最容易抵達的據點。
en: Rifugio Auronzo, at about 2,320 metres,
is the most accessible base, reached by a toll road from Misurina.

zh: 三峰東北方約一公里的洛卡特利小屋，
海拔約兩千四百三十八公尺。
en: Rifugio Locatelli, about a kilometre north-east of the peaks,
stands at about 2,438 metres.

zh: 拉加佐伊纜車，從海拔兩千一百一十七公尺的法爾札雷戈隘口，
升到兩千七百五十二公尺的山屋。
en: The Lagazuoi cable car runs from the Falzarego Pass at 2,117 metres
up to Rifugio Lagazuoi at 2,752 metres.

zh: 義大利電視劇《Un passo dal cielo》，
從2010年起在布拉耶斯湖畔拍攝。
en: The Italian TV series Un passo dal cielo
has been filmed on the shores of Lake Braies since 2010.

zh: 2018年七到九月，湖邊來了超過一百二十萬人；
2020年8月的某一天，就有一萬七千八百七十四人。
en: From July to September 2018 over 1.2 million people came to the lake;
on one day in August 2020 there were 17,874.

zh: 現在湖區實施了入園管理，
開車前往，必須事先預約停車位。
en: An access system now regulates the flow of visitors to the lake,
and drivers must book parking in advance.

zh: 2023年1月30日起，南提洛十八處保護區禁飛無人機，
包括三峰、法內斯-塞內斯-布拉耶斯與普埃茲-奧德勒自然公園。
en: Since 30 January 2023 drones have been banned in 18 protected areas of South Tyrol,
including the Tre Cime, Fanes-Sennes-Braies and Puez-Odle nature parks.

zh: 拉登語、山屋與纜車，
讓人們一代又一代地住在這些山裡。
en: Ladin, mountain huts and cable cars
have let people live among these mountains, generation after generation.

tagline.zh-Hant: 約兩千四百種植物、消失中的冰河、瓦婭風暴，與每年一千萬名遊客
tagline.en: About 2,400 plants, the vanishing Marmolada glacier, Storm Vaia in 2018 and 10 million visitors a year

zh: 多洛米蒂地區大約有兩千四百種植物；
光是貝盧諾多洛米蒂國家公園，就有一千三百五十種。
en: The Dolomites region has about 2,400 plant species;
the Dolomiti Bellunesi National Park alone has 1,350.

zh: 那大約是義大利植物的四分之一，
公園裡還有五十五種森林類型。
en: That is about a quarter of Italy's flora,
and the park has 55 types of forest.

zh: 馬爾莫拉達冰河，是多洛米蒂最大的冰河，
位在山的北側，坡度比較平緩。
en: The Marmolada Glacier is the largest in the Dolomites,
lying on the gentler northern side of the mountain.

zh: 2004到2014年，冰河失去了三成的體積，
預估到2050年就會消失。
en: Between 2004 and 2014 the glacier lost 30% of its volume,
and it is expected to disappear by 2050.

zh: 2022年的崩塌，讓超過二十萬立方公尺的冰與碎石滑下山坡，
另有八人受傷。
en: The 2022 collapse sent over 200,000 m³ of ice and debris down the slope,
and eight more people were injured.

zh: 2018年10月的瓦婭風暴，
吹倒了這一帶數以百萬計的樹木。
en: Storm Vaia in October 2018
tore down millions of trees across the region.

zh: 風暴之後，小蠹蟲大量繁殖，
大片雲杉林枯死，變成了褐色。
en: After the storm a bark beetle infestation spread,
turning large patches of spruce forest brown and dead.

zh: 地方政府正在監測並控制蟲害；
這也被看作是生物多樣性重新發展的機會。
en: Local and regional authorities are monitoring and containing the outbreak;
it is also seen as an opportunity for biodiversity.

zh: 這裡的棲地很多樣，動物也很豐富。
大型肉食動物，正慢慢回到偏遠的山區。
en: With so many different habitats, the fauna is very diverse.
Large carnivores are slowly recolonising remote areas.

zh: 熊（部分是重新引入的）和猞猁，
都已經回到了這片山區。
en: Bears, partly reintroduced, and lynx
have returned to these mountains.

zh: 每年估計有一千萬人造訪多洛米蒂；
新冠疫情之後，遊客還有增加的跡象。
en: An estimated 10 million people visit the Dolomites each year,
with signs of more since the Covid-19 pandemic.

zh: 夏天的三峰一帶非常擁擠，
當局已經研究這裡能承受多少遊客。
en: The Tre Cime area is very crowded in summer,
and a study has looked at how many visitors it can carry.

zh: 在南提洛的遺產鄉鎮，十五年間，
到訪人次增加了百分之六十四點三。
en: In the South Tyrol municipalities of the site
arrivals rose by 64.3% in fifteen years.

zh: 國際自然保護聯盟2025年把前景評為「良好，但有些隱憂」，
其中威脅的程度，被評為「高」。
en: In 2025 IUCN rated the outlook "good with some concerns",
with the threats rated high.

zh: 消退的冰河、倒下的森林與回來的熊，
都在說著這些山正在改變。
en: Retreating ice, fallen forests and returning bears
all tell of mountains that are changing.

tagline.zh-Hant: 九個山系、十八座三千公尺以上的山峰、古代熱帶環礁變成的山，與山崩造成的湖
tagline.en: Nine mountain systems, 18 peaks over 3,000 m, rock from tropical atolls and a lake made by a landslide

zh: 世界遺產由九個山系組成，
面積約十四萬一千九百零三公頃。
en: The World Heritage Site is made up of nine mountain systems
covering 141,903 hectares.

zh: 範圍橫跨三個大區、五個省，
有十八座超過三千公尺的山峰。
en: It spans three regions and five provinces,
with 18 peaks above 3,000 metres.

zh: 最高的是馬爾莫拉達的佩尼亞峰，海拔三千三百四十三公尺，
被稱為「多洛米蒂女王」。
en: The highest is Punta Penia on the Marmolada, 3,343 metres,
known as the "Queen of the Dolomites".

zh: 這些岩石裡，保存了乾燥的平原、熱帶的環礁、
火山與深海的化石紀錄。
en: These rocks preserve fossil records of arid plains, tropical atolls,
volcanoes and deep ocean floors.

zh: 它們也記錄了地球史上最大的滅絕之後，
三疊紀海洋生物的復甦。
en: They also record the recovery of marine life in the Triassic
after the greatest extinction in Earth's history.

zh: 中生代的碳酸鹽台地，
今天變成了一座座陡直、顏色蒼白的山峰。
en: Mesozoic carbonate platforms
have become today's sheer, pale-coloured peaks.

zh: 拉加佐伊山高兩千八百三十五公尺，
山腳的法爾札雷戈隘口，海拔兩千一百一十七公尺。
en: Lagazuoi rises to 2,835 metres;
the Falzarego Pass at its foot is at 2,117 metres.

zh: 往東，是科蒂納丹佩佐所在的山谷；
鎮西的托法納迪梅佐峰，高三千兩百四十四公尺。
en: To the east lies the valley of Cortina d'Ampezzo;
west of the town, Tofana di Mezzo reaches 3,244 metres.

zh: 往東北，就是塞斯托多洛米蒂的拉瓦雷多三峰，
位在南提洛與貝盧諾兩省的交界。
en: To the north-east stand the Tre Cime di Lavaredo in the Sexten Dolomites,
on the border of South Tyrol and Belluno.

zh: 三峰中，大峰高兩千九百九十九公尺，
西峰兩千九百七十三公尺，小峰兩千八百五十七公尺。
en: Of the three, Cima Grande is 2,999 metres,
Cima Ovest 2,973 metres and Cima Piccola 2,857 metres.

zh: 山上還留著第一次世界大戰的
工事、戰壕與坑道。
en: The mountain still holds the fortifications,
trenches and tunnels of the First World War.

zh: 北邊的布拉耶斯湖，是一座堰塞湖：
赫爾斯坦山的山崩擋住了布拉耶斯河，才形成了湖。
en: Lake Braies to the north is a barrage lake:
a landslide from the Herrstein dammed the Prags river and created it.

zh: 湖面海拔一千四百九十六公尺，最深三十六公尺，
長約一點二公里，面積約三十一公頃。
en: The lake lies at 1,496 metres and is up to 36 metres deep,
about 1.2 km long and 31 hectares in area.

zh: 湖邊的塞科費爾山，高兩千八百一十公尺。
山區常有山崩、洪水與雪崩，地形還在變。
en: Above the lake rises the Seekofel, 2,810 metres.
Landslides, floods and avalanches are frequent here, and the land is still changing.

zh: 從古代的熱帶海洋，
到今天蒼白而陡峭的山，這是兩億五千萬年的故事。
en: From ancient tropical seas
to the pale, sheer mountains of today: a story of 250 million years.

sources.title: IUCN World Heritage Outlook: The Dolomites
Dolomiti UNESCO: the World Heritage Site
ENAC: drone flights over parks and nature reserves
